newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING BARINGS UPS UNILEVER TO HOLD.
newsitem.headline: ING BARINGS UPS UNILEVER TO HOLD.

text.p: Summary of Nov 11 research.
Company---------Sector--------Price---Broker----------------
Unilever NV Food/Beverages 275.20 ING Barings Research
Hold (from sell). 12-month price target 280.00 guilders. Q3
results at the high end of forecasts, Europe results much better
than expected, profits showing major turnaround. Detergents and
frozen foods fuelled Europe results. Detergent sector saw lower
marketing costs. Company as a whole benefitted from declining
raw material and packaging costs. Underlying development in
North America strong -- detergents gaining market share as are
premium ice creams. Elizabeth Arden showed signs of improvement.
All regions in emerging markets showed higher profits.
Persistent growth in Brazil supported single-digit volume growth
in Latin America, south-east Asia grew double digits in volume.
In Africa, we doubt the high growth is sustainable. Interest
rates, taxes and currencies all contributed to EPS growth. EPS
growth should be eight percent in 1997 and seven in 1998.
